mapper.select: SELECT mst.app_seq , mst.office_seq , mst.grace_period_seq , mst.grace_period_content AS grace_period_content_code , fn_get_cd_nm('GRACE_PRD_CONT', mst.grace_period_content) AS grace_period_content_name , vtdp."submitDeadLineDate" , vtdp."submitClosingDate" , vtdp."gracePeriodDate" , mst.create_user , mst.create_at , mst.update_user , mst.update_at , mst.del_yn , mst.note FROM utb_app_grace_period mst LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot vtdp ON mst.grace_period_seq = vtdp.tbl_seq WHERE mst.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND mst.app_seq = #{appSeq} AND mst.grace_period_seq = #{gracePeriodSeq} AND mst.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT mst.app_seq , mst.office_seq , mst.grace_period_seq , mst.grace_period_content AS grace_period_content_code , fn_get_cd_nm('GRACE_PRD_CONT', mst.grace_period_content) AS grace_period_content_name , vtdp."submitDeadLineDate" , vtdp."submitClosingDate" , vtdp."gracePeriodDate" , mst.create_user , mst.create_at , mst.update_user , mst.update_at , mst.del_yn , mst.note FROM utb_app_grace_period mst LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot vtdp ON mst.grace_period_seq = vtdp.tbl_seq WHERE mst.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND mst.app_seq = #{appSeq} AND mst.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY mst.create_at ASC
